idea-plugin.name: NIS2 Incident Runbook Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Reads your incident-response runbook and says which of the three Article 23 clocks it gets wrong

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → NIS2 Incident Runbook Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/nis2-incident-runbook-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/nis2-incident-runbook-lint

action.text: NIS2 Incident Runbook Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run NIS2 Incident Runbook Lint on the file in the editor
